findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 8 requests to 4 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 2.6 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 312 kB (12%) came from third-party domains, 45 kB of it from services classified as tracking (2 requests).
1 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: cxense.com (Piano (Cxense), advertising).
